# Harmless text that the grammar filters on purpose. One JSON array per line:
# [input, exact stored output, reason]. A sensitive name followed by a
# separator loses its value, so these are the accepted costs of that rule.
["PWD=/srv/app HOME=/home/app", "PWD=[Filtered] HOME=/home/app", "`PWD` holds `pwd`, and a path after `=` reads like a password"]
["SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = $1 AND auth_provider='github'", "SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = [Filtered] AND auth_provider='github'", "a SQL comparison has the shape of `token_hash = value`"]
["  session: state.session,", "  session: [Filtered]", "a line-start `session:` takes the rest of the line, like a YAML secret"]
["    token = request.headers[\"X-Token\"]", "    token = [Filtered]\"X-Token\"]", "an unquoted value stops at a quote, so the bracket expression is cut there"]
["token_count=5", "token_count=[Filtered]", "a number after `=` is filtered because it can be a PIN"]
["Basic authentication failed", "Basic [Filtered] failed", "`Basic` followed by a long word reads like a Basic credential"]
["Password: changed for user ada", "Password: [Filtered]", "a line-start `Password:` takes the rest of the line"]
["headers.Authorization = `Bearer abcdefghijklmnop`;", "headers.Authorization = `[Filtered]`;", "the quoted value of an Authorization name is the credential"]
["validation failed: password: must be at least 8 characters", "validation failed: password: [Filtered] be at least 8 characters", "`password: must` cannot be told apart from a password that is a word"]

["max_tokens=256", "max_tokens=[Filtered]", "a number after `=` is filtered because it can be a PIN"]
